# Henrix Band

> Henrix Band is a Latvian live cover band for weddings, private parties, jubilees and corporate events — company balls, year-end and Christmas parties, client evenings — across Latvia. Line-ups of 3–5 musicians, a standard 3 × 50 min programme, Latvian and international hits. Prices on request. Site language: Latvian (https://henrix.lv/).

## Line-ups
- Henrix Essential — 3 musicians. Compact format for wedding dinners, private celebrations, jubilees, receptions and smaller corporate events.
- Henrix Live+ — 4 musicians. The most versatile line-up: weddings, jubilees, private parties, company balls, Christmas and year-end parties, mid-size events.
- Henrix Full Experience — 5 musicians (vocals / acoustic guitar, electric guitar, bass, keys, drums). Full concert-party experience for large weddings, balls and celebrations.

## Programme
- Standard: 3 × 50 minute sets; can be split into 4 shorter sets around dinner, host programme, awards, performances or DJ.

## Included
- Band in the chosen line-up, 3 × 50 min programme, programme adapted to the event schedule, instruments and technical equipment, sound for the agreed format, transport, setup and soundcheck, repertoire adapted to the audience.

## Repertoire
- 70+ songs in Latvian, English, Spanish and Portuguese. Examples: Can't Stop The Feeling, September, 24K Magic, Celebration, It's My Life, Simply The Best, Yellow; Latvian: Laternas (Sudden Lights), Ogles (Prāta Vētra), Pa ceļam (Dons), Vējā (Fēlikss Ķiģelis).
